statement: Find all functions \(f : \\mathbb{R} \\to \\mathbb{R}\) such that \(f(ab) = f(a+b)\) for all irrational \(a, b\).
Let \(P(x)\) be a polynomial with real coefficients. Prove that there exist positive integers \(n\) and \(k\) such that \(k\) has \(n\) digits and more than \(P(n)\) positive divisors.
What is the largest shadow that a cube of side length \(1\) can cast, with the sun directly overhead? (The shadow is the largest possible area of the orthogonal projection of the cube onto a plane.)

Let \(ABCD\) be a convex quadrilateral, and let \(M\) and \(N\) be the midpoints of sides \(CD\) and \(AD\), respectively. The lines perpendicular to \(AB\) through \(M\) and perpendicular to \(BC\) through \(N\) intersect at point \(P\). Prove that \(P\) lies on diagonal \(BD\) if and only if the diagonals \(AC\) and \(BD\) are perpendicular.

Determine all values of \(n\) for which there exists a set \(S\) of \(n\) points in the plane, with no three collinear, such that it is possible to color all points of \(S\) so that every angle determined by three points of \(S\) that are all the same color or all three different colors is not obtuse. The number of colors available is unlimited.
Find all pairs \((a, b)\) of positive integers such that \(3^a = 2b^2 + 1\).
